question: Polyglactin 910 (Vicryl) 2-0 is the recommended absorbable suture for repair of the vaginal mucosa and perineal muscle layers of an episiotomy.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Polyglactin 910 (Vicryl) 2-0 is the recommended suture material for episiotomy repair. Non-absorbable sutures (e.g., silk, nylon) are avoided in perineal repair because they require removal and cause more discomfort.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Polyglactin 910 (Vicryl) 2-0 is the standard absorbable suture for episiotomy repair — it provides adequate tensile strength during healing and does not need removal, reducing patient discomfort.
